1. U1 LIVE ROUTING (R3, QS-1) - does a loop rooted at TRUNK locate and drive an instance living in .worktrees/<id>? What-if-wrong: default-branching is unusable and the whole iteration collapses; this is the EXACT untested gap behind defect #2 (note-6815f9db4930). HIGHEST.
2. U2 PROVISION FROM A LINKED-WORKTREE ROOT - v2 is itself a linked worktree (B-log); does `git worktree add .worktrees/<id>` succeed from such a root? What-if-wrong: provisioning fails in the REAL repo even though i5's tests passed against plain `git init` fixtures. HIGH - an untested combination.
3. U3 LOCAL TOP-LEVEL MACHINE LIFT - can machineFor resolve an iteration-local top-level drawing? What-if-wrong: no local trim. LOW - loadIterationMachine + compileMachine already exist; wiring only.
